title: Saul Gets Jealous of David
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight King Saul lets jealousy grow until it turns to anger: Wren stops, breathes, and chooses to be happy about her sister’s new shoes.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she knows how to pause before a feeling grows. In Wren’s world today: her big sister gets new red shoes, and Wren’s old shoes suddenly look very old. A grumpy feeling starts to grow in her tummy. Wren stops, takes a deep breath, and wonders what it would feel like to be happy for her sister instead. She says, “Those are so pretty!” and the grumpy feeling melts away. Unlike King Saul, who let his jealous feeling grow and grow, Wren learned to keep jealousy out of her heart.
